palette.sneakers: violet and ivory, cyan accent replacing orange

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: alternate palette for frame 01 of the oneBeat comic walking character.
Input Image 1: sole edit target and strict authority for all geometry, linework and composition.
Primary request: PALETTE-ONLY RECOLOR of this existing transparent character image. Produce one fresh colorway in the same saturated 2D comic streetwear style, changing colors only, not designing a new character or pose.
New palette mapping:
- Orange bucket/boonie hat becomes rich saturated violet, approximately #8450CE, with darker purple shadow planes. Keep its black ink lines and underside hatching unchanged.
- Blue windbreaker body, blue sleeve areas, collar and ribbed cuffs become warm vivid coral-orange, approximately #F16643. Keep the existing ivory sleeve panels and black bands, zip, pocket details exactly as they are.
- Yellow cargo shorts become saturated cyan/teal blue, approximately #179CAD, with matching darker blue shadow planes. Preserve every pocket, seam, fold and hatch.
- Lavender skin on face, ear, hands and shins becomes warm pale beige/peach, approximately #F2CDAC, with restrained warm tan shadows, not pink, purple or green skin.
- Sneakers keep violet and ivory main panels, charcoal soles and black laces; change their small orange heel/tongue accents to cyan-blue to echo the shorts. Preserve the exact existing panel boundaries, construction and orientation.
- Hair stays ink-black, socks stay black, shirt and ivory fabric/shoe areas stay creamy ivory; eye black/ivory unchanged.
Preserve aggressively: SAME confident hand-inked outer contours, every existing fine hatch and crease line, flat cel-shading finish and shadow boundaries. No re-inking or added texture. SAME silhouette, anatomy, head/hat/limb/hand/shoe positions, scale, crop and margins. The same exaggerated walking pose: near forearm stretched forward, rightward raised shoe toe-up, screen-left planted sneaker, cool half-lidded mouthless profile looking straight forward toward screen-right, never at camera.
Keep the existing low line-drawn ground contact shadow exactly in place, and retain true RGBA transparency everywhere else, including gaps between limbs and fingers. Retain the 1254×1254 square framing, whole character visible.
Avoid: new clothing, accessories, patterns, logos, lettering, border, watermark, mouth, smile, eye direction changes, different gesture, extra shadows, scenery, white/black/gray background or checkerboard pixels, 3D or gradients. Change only the color palette. Output one recolored frame only.
preservation: 另存第一帧配色变体，原版及第 2–8 帧保持不变；未修改客户端运行素材或代码。
